about: ARKBOARD Reference: definitions and methods for every metric and model, plus FV conversion charts per board.

entries.short: Grade on the 20-80 scale of what a prospect becomes at peak: the mean outcome of past players with that profile.
body: 50 average regular, 60 plus, 70 star, 80 generational. Tiers every 5 points, grades in steps of 1.
Each board has its own outcome and rarity ladder. There is no shared cross-sport FV scale.
Headline = mean of the tier odds (busts and stars included), so it sits below the best case.
Graded on absolute talent from a fixed map fit on pooled history, not on rank within a class or board.
Strong classes get more high grades. Age and validated drivers adjust the grade.
entries.where: Every prospect board: CFB, CBB, hockey prospects, soccer prospects, tennis prospects; recruit tabs; MLB boards

entries.short: The realized outcome each FV tier stands for, set by rarity on each board.
body: CFB: NFL career (All-Pro, Pro Bowl, seasons as a starter), 2012-18 drafts.
CBB: peak NBA XPM, as rare as the matching NBA role (7+ All-NBA = 80), careers ending 2008-16.
Hockey: peak NHL pWAR (best 3 of first 7 seasons), rarity in a draft class, 2008-19 classes.
Soccer: peak GAR at ages 22-26, rarity in a birth year and position group, players 22 in 2013-21.
Tennis: peak ranking points above No. 200 at ages 22-28, rarity in a birth year per tour, births 1979-97.
Tennis ATP fit also trains on births after 1997, partial careers imputed to a final outcome.
entries.where: fv model tab on each prospect page; FV conversion charts below

entries.short: Above each board's knot K the headline runs linear to 80 at T, so an 80 comes about once every 5 seasons.
body: Mean of a capped outcome cannot reach 80; the stretch makes 80 reachable but rare (Oct 31 2026).
K = mean that about 3 players a season reach; T = one player per about 5 seasons (exponential tail, held out).
Order is unchanged. The exact mean (fvx) stays in tooltips; above K the headline reads hotter than realized means.
entries.where: Headline FV on every prospect board (data/fv_scale.json)

entries.short: fvx = exact mean outcome; fvg = the pre-outcome grade the tier odds are computed from.
body: Headline FV = round(fvx), stretched above K. fvg feeds fits built on the grade (mock value, recruit stars).
The raw grade is not shown on the site; the outcome step stays (owner decision, Nov 1 2026).
entries.where: Data fields on CFB and CBB boards; tooltips

entries.short: Each player's odds of every outcome tier and their 10th-90th percentile outcome.
body: CFB and CBB: location-scale ordered probit of realized outcome on the grade; cut points at 30, 35 ... 70.
Spread terms kept only if held-out RPS improves (CFB: early season x2.1, walk-on, consensus, underclassman).
Held out: CFB RPS .0398 vs .0408 one spread; CBB .0767. Hockey, soccer, tennis: logistic odds per tier.
Shown in the player dropdown only; main boards show the single headline.

entries.term: Tier chances (NBA%, NHL%, Top%, Reg%, Star%)
entries.short: Chance of reaching a set outcome tier.
body: CBB NBA% = P(plays in the NBA), first rung of the FV model.
Hockey NHL% = 40+ (top 45 of a class); Reg% = 50+ (NHL regular, top 20 of a class).
Soccer Top% = 40+ (top-flight regular, top 250 of a birth year at position); Reg% = 50+ (top 90); Star% = 60+ (top 20).
entries.where: Board columns: CBB, hockey prospects, soccer prospects

entries.short: A + marks a player whose star odds beat the next 2.5 FV, from age.
body: Rule: + when P(60+ | FV, age) >= P(60+ | FV + 2.5). Only age passed held out as an upside signal.
Soccer held out t 5.0 / 4.1 at 55+ / 60+; tennis ATP t 4.3 / 3.3, WTA 3.9 / 3.1. Shares: tennis ~6%, soccer ~30% of top 2000.
CFB + rule failed held out (t -.71 / -.34) and was removed. CBB and hockey signals: none pass.
entries.where: Soccer prospects and tennis prospects boards

entries.short: A grade for a player off the source board: starts at the 20 floor and takes every available driver.
body: Ranked in FV order with a prov tag. CBB: ridge on height, weight, class, age, recruit rank, team top-8 FV (R2 .77).
Hockey: OHL, WHL, QMJHL, AHL and Liiga draft-eligibles off Tankathon, graded on NHLe, age, weight, position.
Soccer: academy-only and youth-international players get their own provisional line.
CFB: ESPN roster backups and carried-over players graded from the 20 floor.

entries.short: Held-out check of each board: graded FV band vs what the players became.
body: Per band: mean FV given vs reached (90% CI), predicted 40+/50+/60+ odds vs realized share.
Slopes: CFB .99, CBB .97, soccer 1.01, tennis ATP .99 / WTA .97; hockey calibrated.
Known heat: WTA 45-64 runs 2.5-4.8 hot; CFB 40+ odds 6-8 pts hot at FV 40-49.
entries.where: fv model tab, fv scorecard window

entries.short: An input enters an FV model only if it cuts held-out error.
body: Hockey, soccer, tennis: t >= 2 across held-out classes/seasons/birth years and wins two thirds of them.
CBB: dropping the driver must raise out-of-sample deviance in 4 of 5 folds (whole players held out).
CFB: multipliers refit leaving one draft class out; kept only if within-position r with NFL AV improves.
entries.where: fv model tabs (drivers kept, out-of-sample evidence)

entries.short: NFL outcome grade for every FBS and FCS player.
body: Composite: production (Stat+, Marcel 5/4/3, regressed), On3 talent, age, frame, combine, badges, XV parts.
Composite rank per class maps to FV by measured NFL outcome counts per position (drafts 2012-18).
Scouting consensus (9 boards + Kiper top 25) blended at weight .5 at full coverage.
Then the outcome step (ordered probit), mean headline, stretched top. Positional value scales elite RB, LB, DL, TE, S.
entries.where: CFB board, draft board, fv model tab

entries.short: NBA outcome grade for every D-I player and listed internationals.
body: E[FV] = 20 + 10 P(30+) + 10 P(40+) + 10 P(50+) + (mean 60+ career - 50) P(60+); one ridge logistic per rung.
Newcomers: recruit rank (On3, 247, Barttorvik), class. Returners: 3-season BPM, conference power, age, size, rates.
Board stage adds June draft-board rank and guard combine testing. E maps to a grade on pooled 2009-16 boards.
Outcome odds are fit on each board's top 300; below that range they scale down to the floor those boards realized (1.8% NBA).
In season: E = (1 - w) preseason + w now, w = minutes / (minutes + k); k 63 newcomers, 128 returners.
entries.where: CBB board, fv model tab, in season window

entries.short: OLS on outcome FV for the draft class and drafted players short of 100 NHL games.
body: Draft model kept: log slot (board rank as slot), draft-year NHLe, defense, goalie, CHL first-round pick, class strength.
Leave-one-class-out error 89.86 vs 95.14 for slot alone (2008-19 classes, 2,541 picks).
After the draft: stage models add latest NHLe, pro games, World Juniors spot, NHL games and WAR so far.
entries.where: Hockey prospects board, drafted prospects, fv model tab

entries.short: OLS on outcome FV for every under-22 in 33 leagues plus academy and feeder leagues.
body: Inputs kept include age, market value (deflated to the fit seasons' level), GAR this and last season,
minutes share, club strength, scoring rate, height, position, PL2 minutes. 53,682 rows, 2013-20.
Detailed position block (centre-back, full-back, defensive / attacking midfield, winger, striker vs central
midfield): season-out error -0.10, t 3.9, 7 of 8 seasons, top 50 and forward test better.
Raw grade = mean of the OLS grade and a gradient-boosted grade (300 trees of depth 3 on every design input,
one set per snapshot): season-out error 55.62 -> 54.62, t 8.7, 8 of 8 seasons. The trees get no missing-height
signal and market values only as dated on a player's own lineups.
Held out by birth cohort: error 54.84 vs 64.42 for age and market value alone (R2 .43).
entries.where: Soccer prospects board, fv model tab

entries.short: Hurdle model for every ATP and WTA player under 22 with a ranking or a pro match in the last year.
body: Logistic for any peak value, OLS on outcome FV given value: FV = (1 - p) x 20 + p x mean given value.
ATP kept: age, rank, unranked, Elo, 52-week win rate, years since pro debut, Futures volume.
WTA kept: age, rank, unranked, Elo, rank x age, tour-qualifying volume. Held out by birth year; OOS R2 .50 / .46.
Height is never an input (the archive fills height for players who made it: a leak).
ATP fit also trains on unfinished careers (later births at imputed targets): as-of 2011-18 error 21.45 -> 20.24, t 7.8, 8 of 8.

ATP tree blend (mean with a boosted-tree grade): as-of 20.24 -> 19.86, t 2.7, 7 of 8, p .015; a second form after the first failed, so it counts in the sweep's Holm family of 15 and misses (needs p <= .005): not used. WTA trees failed forward.
entries.where: Tennis prospects ATP and WTA boards, fv model tab

entries.short: Projected RWA over the next year against tier-1 starters, 20-80 (50 = average tier-1 starter).
body: Prospect = under 20 maps at S-tier events. Projection: rating, age, share of last year's rounds at S/A-tier events.
S/A share is negative on top of the rating's tier lift (held t -4.9). Rise and every stat line failed.
Quarterly cutoffs, fit 2024-25, held out from Jul 2025; a term ships only past the Bonferroni cut of its batch.
Badges (top 25% on a stat) tested on prospects and the main board: none passed, so CS2 shows none.

entries.short: Baseball boards are graded by hand on the FanGraphs 20-80 tiers.
body: No model. Tiers: 80 top 5 overall (7+ WAR a season), 60 All-Star (3.4-4.9), 50 average regular (1.6-2.4).
Boards: 2026 draft hitters v1 (May 7), U19 MiLB prospects, White Sox org top 64.
entries.where: Baseball page (draft hitters, U19 MiLB, White Sox org, fv scale)

entries.short: Projected FV for high school recruits.
body: CFB xFV = P(on board) x FV if on + (1 - P(on)) x 20, year 1; hurdle fit on ESPN 2023-26 classes.
CFB recruit profile weighed on NFL outcomes of 2011-19 classes (24,450 signees, 1,895 drafted); the board sets the level.
Profile inputs: ESPN grade and rank, size, program level and Elo, On3 industry rating, 247 and ESPN vs industry, commit timing.
Held-out schools: rank correlation with NFL outcome .255 (ESPN grade alone .222). Later commits are drafted more at the same grade.

247 composite (CFBD's copy, pulled weekly; 247Sports is never requested) added to P(drafted) for a class CFBD covers (80%+ of ESPN-graded recruits matched): held-out log loss .23136 to .23097, t 2.2 over recruits, 2.17 by school, 6 of 9 classes; classes 2011-15 t 2.56, 2016-19 t .37. It re-orders a class and leaves its level.
Failed Nov 14 2026: track marks, grade by position, tree blend; CBB wider training window, RSCI 1998-2008 classes.
CBB: hurdle on consensus rank and old-for-class; P(reach NBA) then log(FV - 20) given NBA; trained 2009-16.
entries.where: Recruits tabs: 2027-2029 classes, class rankings, recruit model

entries.short: Recruit star rating cut from the projected FV, not the industry stars.
body: CFB: 5-star+ top 6 a class, 5 top 3% of board FV, 4 top 10%, 3 above median, 2 on board, 1 off board (year-3 xFV).
CBB: 5 = 2+ NBA seasons as a starter, 4 = reached the NBA, 3 = D-I starter at BPM +3, 2 = played D-I, 1 = did not.
Arrow = ARK stars minus industry stars.

entries.short: Bronze to platinum trait medals by the name: one stat each, regressed by volume.
body: Tiers at the 75/90/97/99th percentile of the position. CFB badges build archetypes.
On other boards a badge shows only if it predicts the sport's own outcome held out beyond the value metric.
Display only: no badge feeds FV or projections. Volume and usage traits pass; efficiency rates mostly fail.
entries.where: Every board (medals by the name), player cards

entries.short: Each player's grade at their best season, listed by position.
body: CFB rebuilds every FBS season 2014-25; box-score era (2014-18) means recalibrated to NFL outcomes.
CFB outcome: NFL AV a season since the draft over a class horizon index h (mean 1 on 2020-23 drafts), so old classes' out-of-league years don't count against them.
Other boards read their past lists; only grade-complete rows are used.
entries.where: all-time FV tab on CFB, CBB, hockey, soccer and tennis prospect pages

entries.short: Wins over a replacement starter in a 12-game season.
body: WAR = snap share x (line + weight x quality) x .227; 1 pt of margin a game = .0189 win% (928 FBS team seasons).
Line = margin lost when an average starter sits: QB 2.7, RB 1.7, EDGE 1.4, WR 1.35, CB 1.3, S 1.1, DT 1.0, LB 1.0.
Quality from Stat+, badges and FV. QB keeps 1.25 pts per SD; the rest goes to offensive teammates by snaps.
Replacement lineup wins .18 (2 of 12); an average team's starters total 3.8 WAR.
entries.where: CFB board, WAR leaders tab, team talent

entries.short: WAR minus snap share x line: wins over an average starter at the position.
body: Comparable across positions; below average < 0.

entries.short: WAA a full season: WAA / snap share, wins over an average starter if he played every snap.
body: Shown at a snap share of .2+. A rescale of the WAR quality term into wins; no shrunk version: snap shares exist for 2026 only, and regressing college WAR to the mean failed forward (Oct 16 2026).

entries.short: WAR with quality from the stat-line parts that track winning.
body: CFB: PFN score plus position parts (QB cmp %, yds/att, INT rate; OL pressure rate; DT splash; CB yds/target).
Fit on 2024-25 team margin. Held out team r .88 vs .86 for WAR quality; win% r .73 vs .68.
NFL: same idea fit to team margin per game; on missed games t 4.9 vs 2.1 for AV WAR.
Next-season forecasts tie with WAR, so projections and game models stay on WAR.
entries.where: CFB and NFL WAR leaders tabs (XV column)

entries.short: Wins over replacement: .6 x AV WAR + .4 x XV, season to date.
body: AV WAR = (AV - replacement AV at the sub-position x snap share) x .091 wins per AV.
.091 from team wins on team AV (160 team seasons 2021-25, r .86). Replacement team wins 3 of 17.
Defensive AV rebuilt from pressures, stops and plays on the ball. Two-way players earn WAR on each side.

1Y / 3Y: next-season and three-season WAR from WAR pace, the two seasons before, snaps, age by position group, and the market read (draft slot on a rookie deal, cap share after). Market inputs pre-registered Nov 13 2026: 1Y RMSE .1403 to .1395 (t -3.1), 3Y .3264 to .3236 (t -3.6, 8/8 seasons).
entries.where: NFL WAR leaders, team WAR, rookies, breakouts

entries.short: Points of team margin over an average regular at the sub-position per 60 snaps, this season, as played.
body: (WAA - special teams WAR) x 35.5 points a win / snaps x 60. WAA is the board's WAR minus what an average regular at the sub-position (slot WR, nickel CB, OT, IOL, ...) adds in the same snaps.
Qualified: 40% of his team's snaps on his side so far (the XV regular line). The per 60 snaps view shows qualified players only; blank under 100 snaps.
Year-to-year r (100+ snaps both seasons, 2016-25): TE .60, RB .55, QB .48, WR .46, DL .39, OL .29, LB .24, DB .18. Snaps to r .5: RB 300, TE 450, WR / DL 900, QB 1,300, OL / LB 1,800, DB 2,600.
entries.where: NFL WAR leaders (rXP/60 column, per 60 snaps view)

entries.short: Headline NFL rate, shown beside WAR: three seasons of rXP/60, shrunk by snaps toward a prior set by position and the market.
body: (rate x snaps this season + .7 x last season + .5 x the season before, + K x prior) / (weighted snaps + K). K snaps: QB 900, RB 450, WR 900, TE 300, DL 900, LB 1,300, OL 2,600, DB 3,600. A rookie has no past seasons, so his is this season alone, shrunk by the same K.

Prior = sub-position mean + slope x (market read - its mean). Market read: -ln(draft pick) through the fourth season (undrafted = 300), ln(APY share of the cap) of the contract in force after that (OverTheCap). Slopes in points per 60 per log unit, rookie deal / later contract: QB .07 / .25, RB .23 / .26, WR .12 / .21, TE .19 / .37, DL .11 / .18, LB .04 / .07, DB .03 / .07, OL .00 / .02. Pre-registered Nov 13 2026: next-season MSE .2485 to .2438, t -4.85, 9/9 seasons, calibration slope 1.00.

Fit on next season's rXP/60 (100+ snaps, weighted by snaps), 2016-24 board seasons, K chosen leaving each season out. MSE .244 vs .832 raw, .310 position mean, .256 one season shrunk (t -4.2). Better than raw every season (9/9; t -18.8 on 100+ snap players).

Failed: prior moved by playing time (t -.2 vs plain), age hinge at 27 by group (t -1.7). Pct = pXP/60 percentile at the position among qualified players in the filters. Game model input (active roster's preseason pXP/60 x snap share, home minus away; with QBs, fading, absences only): all fail, 2015-20 t +.2 to +.5, 2021-25 t -.6 to +1.3, nothing over the close (t .05). Board only.

entries.short: Production index: 100 + 25 x z of the position all-in-one score this season.
body: Source score: PFN QB+, RB+, WR+, TE+, OLi, EDGE+, DT+, LB+, CB+, SAF+; K and P by percentile.
z against the snap-weighted position mean, FBS or FCS. 125 = 1 SD above average.
FV production driver; validity vs NFL AV: TE .52, WR .50, QB .48, RB .48, EDGE .40, LB .40, DT .37.
entries.where: CFB board, WAR leaders, true freshmen

entries.short: xNIL = NIL market worth now; yNIL = estimated pay entering the season; zNIL = xNIL - yNIL.
body: xNIL = position price x on-field value (AV at FV, x playing time), shared within P4 and G5 pools.
yNIL = program budget split by a preseason index (P4 ~$20M, G5 ~$3M, FCS ~$0.4M a program).
Not fit to On3 valuations (they move only +18% per 10 FV). zNIL growth is 20% of each coach score.
FCS players at FBS-starter FV priced at 40% of the FBS rate. CBB xNIL: minutes share x (BPM + 3) at school price.
entries.where: CFB board, team talent, team builder, fv to xNIL charts; CBB recruits

entries.short: College on-field value a season: snap share x position weight x quality.
body: Quality = Stat+ z + .5 badge z + .25 FV z. Team R2 vs 2026 SRS .63 vs .44 for summed FV value.
Used for college injury cost and team value; NFL value stays on AV at FV.
entries.where: CFB team talent (Season AV), fv to war chart

entries.short: NBA impact: .5 databallr DPM + .5 Basketball-Reference BPM, points per 100 possessions over average, as played.
body: The headline XPM on every NBA board. O-XPM and D-XPM are the same blend of each side.
Feeds VORX, the game models (which shrink it themselves) and the CBB board target. BPM only where no DPM row (*).
XPM and rookie boards default to qualified: 1,000 MP per 82 team games. Qualified rookies 2010-23: rXPM orders next-three-season VORX .607 (VORX .604); all rookies .330.
entries.where: NBA VORX/XPM leaders, rookies, team pages, ARKLIST

entries.short: rXPM shrunk by minutes toward what he is expected to be.
body: raw x MP / (MP + 600) + mean x 600 / (MP + 600).
Mean = role mean + r x (Marcel prior - role mean), r = H / (H + 1,000), H = MP last season + .5 x MP the season before.
Role mean = -1 + .5 ln(1 + MP82 / 100). Fit on next-season XPM 2011-26, leave one season out: RMSE 1.235 vs 1.259 role mean only, 1.59 raw.

entries.short: NBA wins over replacement: .030 x (rXPM + 1.4) x MP / 48.
body: Replacement rXPM -1.4; both constants fit to team wins (480 team seasons 2011-26). Default sort of the XPM and rookie boards.
Rookies 2010-23, held out: VORX orders next-three-season VORX best (Spearman .398; pXPM .395, aXPM .379, rXPM .330).
Next-three-season XPM: the rookie 3Y orders it best (.481; aXPM .413, rXPM .417, VORX .351).
entries.where: NBA VORX/XPM leaders, projections, contract value

entries.short: Projected XPM next season and over the next three, minutes-weighted, given he plays.
body: From XPM (proj), age, projected minutes, a hinge above +3, and the two seasons before; coefficients by share of the season played.
Fit on seasons with minutes, weighted by them. The chance he is off the board is not in it.
Held out 2012-23, 1,000+ minutes in the window: 3Y RMSE 1.13, 1Y 1.14; bias within .25 at every level. Display only.

entries.short: Season-to-date XPM blended with a preseason prior by minutes.
body: prior + (XPM - prior) x MP / (k + MP); k 509 veterans, 809 newcomers (7,269 player seasons 2012-26).
80% range covers .806 / .799 held out. Display only.

entries.short: Minimum salary + projected VORX x market $ per win, minus salary, every year left.
body: $ per win = payroll above the minimum / league projected VORX, refit on each update; +7% a year (assumption).
Player option counted only when it pays the player; team option only when it pays the team.

entries.short: The AAV a player would sign for as a free agent now: a share of the cap from position, age and last full season.
body: Fit on real signings, held out a signing year at a time against the mean by position x age. Forms pre-registered; live form = lowest held-out MAE whose top end is calibrated (priced 7%+ of the cap -> signed for 85-115% of it). Square root of the cap share, smeared back; clipped to the league minimum and maximum.

NHL: 3,241 CapWages deals 2010-26 (standard, 35+, two-way; no ELCs or extensions). WAR, pWAR, 3Y, points and TOI a game, games, age by F/D/G. MAE .83% of the cap vs 1.70 (t -40, 17/17 seasons; forward 11/11). Points and TOI alone tie it (t -1.4): the market pays for points.

NFL: 12,192 OverTheCap veteran contracts 2014-26 (3+ years after the draft). WAR last two seasons, snaps, games, age by position. MAE .86% vs 1.50 (t -52, 13/13; forward 9/9). WAR adds over snaps alone (t -18). Ceiling = record 24.5% (Burrow 2023).

NBA: 1,334 Basketball-Reference offseason signings 2011-26 (free agent, multi-year or plain contracts; next season salary on the signing team). XPM last two seasons, VORX, minutes, points and minutes a game, games, age, years in the league. MAE 2.60% vs 5.04 (t -19, 16/16; forward 11/11). XPM/VORX add over points and minutes alone (t -6, 14/16). Max 25/30/35% by years in the league; 2026-27 cap $165M (projected).
Soccer: not built. No public wage data reachable (Capology blocks); xMV is the transfer-market equivalent.
entries.where: NBA, NFL, NHL contract value tabs

entries.short: Projected Barttorvik BPM this season.
body: Ridge on last season, recruiting, age, size; in season blends to-date BPM.
Team context (Nov 3 2026): returning teammates' WAR, teammates' recruiting (top 8 -ln rank), WAA, transfer up/down.
Forward 2020-26 RMSE: returners 2.558 -> 2.462 (t 18), newcomers 3.439 -> 3.229 (t 14). Not an FV input.

entries.short: Wins over a replacement / average D-I player.
body: WAR = (BPM + 2) x minutes / 40 x 68 possessions a 40 / 100 x .0143 wins a point; WAA uses BPM.
Replacement BPM -2.0 = the 9th man in team minutes (2025-26). Wins a point fit on 3,485 team seasons 2017-26:
wins = .395 x games + team WAR (r .86). The textbook slope (.0347 at margin sd 11.5) overstates: schedules
pair strong with strong and win odds flatten at the ends. FV test: WAR, WAA, career and 5/4/3 WAR fail.
entries.where: CBB WAR leaders, stats, portal, returning

entries.short: BPM against the position: 100 + 25 x z.
body: z = (BPM - position mean) / position sd. Tabs: last season's norms (G -.23 / 3.84, F .57 / 4.13, C 1.71 / 4.56),
then this season's own once 40 players a position qualify. FV driver norms: G .10 / 3.85, F .50 / 4.05, C .52 / 4.31 (2008-16).
FV driver (Nov 3 2026): passes three fold rules (t 2.9-3.5, 4-5/5), held 2017-19 (+.17) and forward 2020-23 (+.26).
entries.where: CBB stats, WAR leaders, portal; FV inputs

entries.short: Hollinger single-game value.
body: PTS + .4 FGM - .7 FGA - .4 (FTA - FTM) + .7 ORB + .3 DRB + STL + .7 AST + .7 BLK - .4 PF - TOV.
FV and xBPM tests (a game, a 40, best game, 20+ games): all fail.

entries.short: 1st-2nd year players above their preseason projection.
body: xBPM up = live xBPM - preseason xBPM (minutes-blended). Also BPM over x, minutes, usage and FV gains.
Last season view: 2nd-years against their freshman line (WAR, BPM, minutes, usage gains).
FV tests: WAR gain, minutes gain, usage gain, BPM x (1 - minutes share) all fail (low-minute BPM passes the folds, not the top of the board).

entries.short: Team tables: last season's minutes and WAR back; roster grades.
body: Ret Min% = last season's minutes still on the roster (Barttorvik ids). In WAR = incoming transfers' WAR.
Talent = mean FV of the top 8. xNBA = sum of NBA%. TvE = talent rank - ARK rank.
FV tests: vacated minutes (opportunity), returning teammates' WAR, teammates' recruiting fail; the last two pass for xBPM.

entries.short: CBB FV target: mean of a career's best three NBA XPM seasons, each shrunk toward -2 by 500 minutes.
body: FV bands start at the XPM as many careers reached as reached the matching NBA role. See the CBB chart.

entries.short: Descriptive wins over replacement at goal value.
body: 5v5 on-ice xG vs teammates, PP xG /5, PK /4, finishing (goals - ixG), penalties, share of team leftover xG.
Goalies: GSAx at full credit. Sums to team goal differential (R2 .991).
Replacement = players outside each team's top 13 F / 7 D / 2 G.

entries.short: Projected WAR and projected goals per 60 over an average player.
body: HPM = Marcel-weighted (1 / .5 / .25) shrunk rates, components weighted by how well they carry to next season.
pWAR = (HPM - replacement) x TOI / 60 / goals per win. LOSO R2 .37 vs .26 before (t 4.24, 15/17 seasons).
Goalie GSAx barely repeats (weight .21), so goalie pWAR ~0.4 while goalie WAR runs ~7.
entries.where: NHL WAR leaders, backup watch, rookies; hockey prospect outcome (skaters)

entries.short: WAR's goals above replacement a 60 minutes this season (descriptive rate; HPM is the predictive one).
body: GAR / TOI x 60. A Marcel of GAR/60 (1, .8, .6; shrunk by 20 h F, 80 h D) forecasts next season's GAR/60 better than HPM (t -5.0, 16/17) but not for players who changed teams (t -1.3): the gain is team context. As the game model's lineup value in place of HPM it is worse (tune t +2.1, held +1.7, Nov 14 2026). HPM stays.

entries.short: Goals saved above expected (MoneyPuck xG).
body: Goalie tab shows GSAx a game shrunk toward a new goalie's level; feeds the NHL totals model.

entries.short: NHL points a full season at a league's translation factor.

entries.short: WAR: wins above replacement over 52 weeks. PA: points won a 100 points over an average top-100 player, opponent-adjusted.
body: WAR = wins - sum of P(a replacement player beats the same opponents), every level, last 52 weeks. Replacement = the median pre-match Elo of players ranked 101-150 at their matches since 2005 (ATP 1900, WTA 1884), surface-blended Elo, best of five where played. Recomputed with every rating refit, since the Elo scale moves with the K schedule.

PA a match = serve points won - what a serve rating of 0 wins against this returner + return points won - what a return rating of 0 wins against this server (the points filter's opponent ratings before the match). rPA = 100 x sum / points, last 52 weeks. PA (headline) = each match weighted .5 ^ (days ago / 365), shrunk by 300 points. Both shown against the average top-100 player.

Pre-registered Nov 14 2026, Holm over 5. Next 52 weeks' rPA (1,000+ points), held out by year 2011-26: MSE 3.76 vs raw 4.37 (t -12.5) and the Kalman serve + return ratings 4.80 (t -19.1), 16/16 years; half-life and K the same every year left out. WAR vs the next year-end ranking: Spearman +.12 over 52-week wins (t 4.3, 25/30 tour-years), +.26 over W-L; the same year's ranking: no better than wins (t 0.9, fail).

Game model: PA gap / 10 is a blend term (CP). Walk-forward held 2023-26 log loss -9.8e-4 (t -4.1 by tournament), close period -13.4e-4 (t -3.2); gap to the close .0092 to .0079. WAR a match gap alone -1.6e-4 (t -2.0), nothing beside PA: not in the blend.
Prospects FV: WAR and points over the Elo gap fail as drivers (ATP t -2.3 / -1.0, WTA +.3 / +1.2).

His head coach's moves are mixed in: P(school) = (1 - f H) s + f h, h = P(his coach takes that job), H = sum of h, f = share who follow (CFB .35; CBB from the fit's follow term).
Top-school reliability, held out: CFB mean top share 5.0% vs 3.9% hit; CBB 4.3% vs 4.0% (top shares of 10-20% hit 6-8% in CFB, 21-24% in CBB).

Failed (Nov 14 2026, pre-registered, gate t >= 2 held out): temperature on the landing odds (CFB, CBB: best fit 1.0); CBB ex-coach reunion (t 1.82 / 1.47; 11x the random rate, 1% of moves); CBB open minutes at his position (t 1.83 / 4.52); CBB 3-point style fit (t 1.54 / .94). entries.short: P(player wins the award): a voter model fit on past voting, averaged over simulated rests of the season.
body: Voter model: rank-ordered logit on each season's pool (P(1st) = softmax of features, then 2nd among the rest, 3 places deep where vote order is public; winner only for CBB and NFL). L2 1, features standardized.

Features: the board's value metric + box stats + team success + narrative (prior wins, games played, position). NBA MVP: VORX, XPM, PPG, W%, 1 seed, games, prior MVPs. NHL Hart: WAR, points, goals, team points %, games, goalie, prior Harts. Heisman, Maxwell, Walter Camp: yards, TDs, INTs, W%, QB, defender, last year's top 5. O'Brien: pass yards, TDs, INTs, YPA, rush yards, W%. Ray Guy: gross, net, inside 20, punts. Wooden: BPM, PPG, W%, barthag, minutes, power conference.

Test: leave one season out, log P(actual winner) vs the value metric alone (NBA VORX / D-XPM, NHL WAR / GSAx, CBB BPM; football yards + TDs). Ships when the paired t passes Holm at .05 across the sport's awards and the model wins most seasons.

Held out: NBA MVP 13/17 winners picked (VORX alone 9), DPOY 7/17, ROY 12/15; NHL Hart 8/17 (WAR 4), Norris 8/17, Vezina 10/17, Calder 7/15; Wooden 11/19 (BPM 2); Heisman 7/21 (box 5); NFL MVP 14/21, OPOY 11/21, OROY 10/21. NFL DPOY failed (t .8): not shown.

Other CFB awards, winner only, 2005-25, null = the award's two headline stats: Maxwell 6/21 (t 5.1), Walter Camp 5/21 (t 4.0), O'Brien 12/20 (pass yards + TDs 5, t 6.6), Ray Guy 10/20 (gross average 8, t 5.7) ship. Failed Holm over 13 CFB awards: Doak Walker (t .1), Biletnikoff (.9), Mackey (1.6), Bednarik (2.5), Nagurski (2.0), Butkus (2.7), Thorpe (.5), Groza (1.4). Not modelled: Outland, Lombardi, Rimington (no lineman box stats), Broyles and coach of the year.

Added Nov 14 2026, same gate: NFL DROY (rookie defenders from nflverse weekly lines; sacks, INTs, TFL, PDs, FF, tackles, TDs, W%, first-round pick) 12/21 winners (sacks + INTs alone 7, t 4.0). All-NBA as a top-15 race (the logit run down the 15 slots; VORX, XPM, PPG, RPG, APG, W%, games, prior All-NBA teams): 203 of 255 named in its top 15 (VORX alone 190, t 5.3); P(team) = share of simulations in which he is in a Plackett-Luce draw of 15. Ballon d'Or (award years 2015-26, big-five players, top 150 by GAR; GAR, goals + assists, league title, Champions League won / final, World Cup / Euro / Copa America won, prior wins): 8/11 winners (GAR alone 2, t 4.0); league and Champions League winners are drawn from the season odds. AP All-Pro not modelled.

Simulation: 3,000 rests of the season. Team finish from the board's season odds; player rates toward last season (NBA shrunk XPM, NHL pWAR a minute, CBB BPM by 300 minutes), Poisson injuries with lognormal length; NBA 65-game rule for MVP and DPOY.

In-season backtest (scripts/awards_asof.py): to-date lines rebuilt at 25 / 50 / 75% of each past season and run through the same simulation, voter model refit without that season. NFL 2005-25 from nflverse weekly; NHL 2010-11 on from the stats API by date and the goalie archive; NBA 2012-13 on from archived box lines; WAR and XPM stand in as box-stat estimates (they exist only as season files). Favourite's P vs hit rate at 25 / 50 / 75%: NBA .43 / .56 / .59 vs .38 / .40 / .48; NHL .41 / .44 / .50 vs .22 / .37 / .44; NFL .41 / .47 / .49 vs .25 / .30 / .38. A temperature by season share (p^(1/T), T = 1 + a x share left, a fit leaving a season out) did not pass on log loss: NBA a 0 (t 0), NHL a .5 (t -1.3), NFL a .5 (t -.2). Not applied. CFB and CBB not backtested (no by-date source for the inputs).

Mkt: Polymarket mid of a two-sided quote, no vig, display only. Failed for the Heisman vs the shipped model: position-relative yards (t .6), passing and scrimmage yards and TDs split (t 1.0), plus a two-way term (t .9).

body: Leave: multinomial logit on school-seasons (CFB 2010-25, CBB 2016-25): projected win% (season sim), vs program norm, first or second year, level x win%. Held out: CFB AUC .72 (2020-25), CBB .65 (2022-25). Interim coaches: job opens 80%.

Landing jobs: each opening's P(opens) x the hire model's share of sitting head coaches (pay or level step up, results, conference, distance), scaled to his P(hired away). Held out, the hire is in the top 10 for 29% (CFB, random 8%) and 31% (CBB).
Failed: pay over level median in the hot seat (CFB Oct 2026, CBB Nov 14 2026 t .25). Buyouts: only the current year is public, so untestable.

entries.short: Head coaches ranked by Score, in wins: value over what the program does with other coaches, plus titles weighted the way the Halls of Fame weigh them.
body: WAx: each season, wins over the program's expectation on a standard season (CFB 12 games, CBB 30): G x [Phi(r/s) - Phi(e/s)], s = the decade's points-to-wins probit scale.
Expectation e: the program's other coaches' seasons within 15 years (weight exp(-gap/6), the 2 seasons after he leaves skipped), shrunk 1 season toward the conference that year.
Ratings: CFB ridge SRS from every major-college game since 1900; CBB Sports Reference SRS from 1950, 1939-49 estimated from win% and conference.
cWAR = WAx + 1.23 (CFB) / 2.41 (CBB) a season: replacement level = the mean season of coaches with two or fewer seasons.

NT / CT: national and conference title shares, ties split. CFB national: AP from 1936, AP + Coaches Poll halves from 1950, share of major-selector picks before 1936. CFB conference: title game, else best conference record. CBB: NCAA title; regular-season conference title.
Title difficulty: log2(1 + sum exp(z/t)) over the field (z = season rating z-score, t = 0.25 fit on who won), over its mean.

Score = cWAR + 52 a national title + 8.5 a conference title (CFB); 108 + 31.5 (CBB). Weights: logistic fit of Hall of Fame selection on cWAR, NT, CT (done by 2019, 8+ seasons; 136/443 CFB, 71/787 CBB), title coefficient / cWAR coefficient.

Coord (CFB): OC/DC unit points over the program's unit expectation, 1990-2025, in wins (column). In Score x 0.06 = slope of later head-coach WAx rate on coordinator rate (n 121, t 0.46; OC r 0.09, DC r -0.07): coordinator results barely carry. CBB: no assistant history.
Hall of Fame AUC: Score 0.89 vs raw wins 0.90 (CFB); 0.88 vs 0.83 (CBB).
Movers (old-job WAx rate vs new job, 3+ seasons each): CFB r 0.14 (n 373, t 2.69); CBB r 0.20 (n 754, t 5.51).
Walk-forward from 2010: shrunk WAx predicts the next 10 seasons' WAx at r 0.19 CFB / 0.37 CBB (win% 0.19 / 0.12); Score per season predicts next-10 title equity at r 0.40 / 0.60 (win% 0.09 / 0.43).
Stability: top-100 rank correlation across expectation settings (decay 3-12, shrink 1-3, no skip) 0.97+ CFB, 0.98+ CBB; odd/even-season WAx split-half 0.75 / 0.82.

NBA / NHL: the same method on Sports Reference SRS (NBA points, NHL goals), an 82-game season, the franchise as the program (one id through relocations), league title = national title, a place in the Finals / Stanley Cup Final = conference title; a coach replaced in season gets his share of the games. Seasons with an SRS on file: 1947-2026 / 1922-2026.

NBA / NHL replacement level 8.61 / 5.04 wins a season; Score = cWAR + 166 / 39 a title + 0.0 / 3.2 a Finals appearance. Hall of Fame label: NBA the Naismith Coach category (17/45); NHL the Hockey Hall of Fame Builder category (11/29; that Hall has no coach class, and coaches inducted as players are left out of the fit).

NBA / NHL tests: Hall of Fame AUC Score 0.96 / 0.89 vs raw wins 0.85 / 0.66; movers r 0.17 (n 100, t 1.75) / 0.15 (n 89, t 1.4); walk-forward from 2010: shrunk WAx to next-10 WAx r -0.07 / -0.14 (win% 0.03 / -0.11), Score per season to next-10 title equity r 0.52 / -0.12 (win% 0.36 / 0.02); split-half 0.74 / 0.86.

entries.short: Round win % by buy class against buy class, pistol conversion, and force against save, from pro round data.
body: Buy class = team equipment value after the buy: eco under 5,000, force 5,000 to 19,999, full 20,000+. Pistol rounds are their own class. Regulation rounds of maps since Jan 2024 with bo3.gg round data (61,254 maps), all tiers and by bo3.gg event tier; tier C is the baseline on the 1NT page.
Full v full the T side wins 49%; full v force 73% (T full) and 29% (T force v CT full); an eco wins 6% against a full buy.
Pistol conversion: the pistol winner takes the next round 84% (T) / 81% (CT) of the time.

Force v save: the round after a lost round, short of a full buy; value = rounds won over that round and the next. Forcing after a lost pistol is worth +0.12 rounds over saving (se 0.004). The data has no bank, so the losing streak stands in for money, and who forces is the teams' choice: a comparison, not an experiment.
Cells under 200 rounds are dimmed. Descriptive: no opponent or map adjustment, and not a model input.

body: Seasons split into tuning (terms enter) and held out (report and veto). Errors clustered by game day.

entries.short: Shared rule for every model term.
body: Evidence = the held-out t alone (drop-one); the tuning t is shown, not combined. One Benjamini-Hochberg family over all terms with a held-out split.
Keep at q <= .10; drop at q > .10 when held-out loss is no worse without it; otherwise watch. No held-out split = watch.
Terms past 365 days are flagged for re-test.

entries.short: Model minus the market, in points (spread, total) or chance (moneyline, tennis).
body: Edge % on the full table = raw model chance minus the no-vig market chance.
Gaps past 5 sd are treated as bad lines; picks between 3 and 5 sd are staked at the cap.

entries.short: A pick is the model's side when |model - line| >= X for that sport and market.
body: X = smallest gap whose calibrated return at -103 is > 0 on tuning seasons.
A market or segment is on only if held-out picks beat the close (clvRet > 0, t >= 1.65, n >= 30).
One pick a game per market family. Bet to = worst line that still clears X.

entries.short: Expected return at the price, from held-out picks judged by the close.
body: Edge = min(EV, a + b (gap - mean gap)); a blends close value and ROI; b = the market's own slope, shrunk.
History priced at Polymarket US -112 (after its fee; Novig -103 before Nov 15 2026). TIMING .5 halves every backtest edge (live bets come after part of the move).
Chance at the bet line = the market mid there (from both asks) + the calibrated chance edge; gap measured from the market fair line.
NBA backtest edge also x.5 (history saw tip-time injury news the open did not).

entries.short: Stake as % of bankroll: Kelly on the calibrated edge x the book's live realization, compounding.
body: Formerly Dengler Units (DU); 1 DU = 1% of bankroll. Picks qualify where the edge at the price > 0.
Cap 5% a bet (tennis 2%). Joint slate Kelly gave the same growth as per-pick (rho ~0).
Walk-forward: 1x Kelly most log growth at the backtest edge and at half of it.

Stake x: r = close value per point of staked edge on the book's live picks, normal update around .5 (sd .25), clipped 0-1. Walk-forward by game day it beat posted stakes at the close (all books -21.7% -> -6.4% log growth; NBA +0.81% -> +1.05%).

entries.short: Every flagged pick, live and paper, judged out of sample.
body: Close value and ROI with 95% ranges clustered by game day; one-sided p on G - 1 df.
Holm across the books (the unit that goes live or paper) and across rules with 8+ game days, family-wise .05.
Win - chance: win rate minus the stake's chance; Brier skill against the close's chance at the pick's price.
Venue: Polymarket US after its taker fee (.095 p(1 - p)) from Nov 15 2026; Novig where it has no game, then DraftKings.

body: Close = last snapshot before the start. CLV = points the line moved our way.
Worth at close (clvRet) = return the pick was worth at the closing price, with t.
CLV needs far fewer bets than results for t 2 (CBB 5+ pts: ~228 vs ~402).

body: close - open = b x (model - open) + controls. b: CFB spread .10, CFB total .22, CBB .10, NBA spread .24, total .42.
Break-even gap = where a -110 bet at the open breaks even at the predicted close.

entries.short: Live switch that stops a losing pick rule until a refit.
body: Judged after 50+ picks, by game day, each day over 1 + (n - 1) rho (rho = within-slate correlation of close value, held-out picks).
Stop if CUSUM around zero S = max(0, S - clvRet / sd - .25) >= 10, or CUSUM of the log likelihood ratio (no edge vs the stakes' edge) >= ln 99.
Last-300 clustered t (se floored at iid) is shown, not a stop.

About 250 (NBA totals) to 430 (CBB, CFB totals) bets to stop a rule with no edge.

Against the book's close (ESPN BET, then DraftKings, through ESPN, 2024-06 on): 0.8485 vs 0.8349; level with the open (0.8485 vs 0.8499).

entries.short: Match win chance from three ratings blended in log-odds, plus match context.
body: Elo on wins: everyone starts at the same rating; K falls with matches played, so a newcomer moves fast and a veteran slowly. One overall rating and one per surface, blended; retirements count at a discount, and so do Challenger and WTA 125 results (x0.85: results a level down carry over to the tour a little less than Elo assumes).
Games won: a rating in log-odds of winning a game, moved by the share of games won against the opponent's rating, part surface-specific. It reads a 6-1 6-1 win as more than a 7-6 7-6 one.

Serve and return points: opponent-adjusted serve and return strength from points won on serve, a Kalman filter per player (new players and long layoffs move faster), run through the game, tiebreak, set and match chain for best of three or five. It also gives SPW+ / RPW+.

Match context, player minus opponent: rest, age (ratings trail a young player's rise and an old player's decline), head-to-head lead, recent workload and the market's memory of the player (mean of the last 8 closing prices minus the ratings' chance). Context is not used in the ARK Ranking.
Walk-forward over every ATP and WTA singles match since 2005; tuned on 2012-22 tour-level main draws, 2023 on held out.

entries.short: Model side when it differs from the market no-vig price (Polymarket US, else Novig) by 4+ points of win chance.
body: Calibrated chance = no-vig + .5 x k toward the model (k .25 logits). Cap 2% a bet.
Tour-level main draws; tuned 2025, held out 2026: 1,935 picks, +4.5% worth at close (t 19).

entries.short: Each player's chance to reach every round and win the title, for every tour-level draw in progress.
body: 10,000 simulations of the rest of the draw from the tennis game model (surface, match context, best of 5 for men at the Slams). Played matches are fixed; listed pairings are played as drawn.

ESPN lists a match once both players are known, so later pairings are drawn by the seeding principle: in each round the better-ranked half of the players left meets the other half at random. Early-round numbers are therefore averaged over where the draw could fall.
Shown once the field is complete (a 1000 event from round 2, where its byes show). Round-robin events are left out.

Check on 327 past draws rebuilt from results, 2023 to Oct 2026, real brackets: title log loss 2.62 against 2.65 on Elo alone (t -1.3) and 2.78 on ranking alone (t -3.0). Better than ranking, level with Elo; the blend weights are today's, so this is a check and not a held-out score.
Registered: scored once against outright prices after the 2027 Australian Open, from an append-only record of each event's first odds.

entries.short: Series win chance from player Elo, region offsets, a team map rating, Valve's VRS points and the five's RWA.
body: Player Elo, map by map: a series found on bo3.gg updates once per map on round share, so 13-3 moves a rating more than 13-11; other series update on the series result. K starts high for a new player and falls over about 100 series. Players new after March 2024 start below average; everyone starts from Valve's 2022-23 sample season played forward with the same rules.
Region offsets for Europe, the Americas and Asia, moved only by inter-region series.

Team map rating from bo3.gg's map results since June 2020: a team Elo moved by round share on every map, plus each team's offset on each map. A series chance comes from a simple veto (each side bans its worst map and picks its best, both orders averaged).
Valve's VRS points from the snapshot before each day, blended in log-odds, with separate weights when both teams are VRS top 50: Valve's points carry real information at the top and little below it.
Only maps played to the end (13+ rounds) update on round share; bo3.gg lists forfeits as 1-0.

Where Thunderpick prices a series, the shown chance blends the price with the model (weights refit each build on the archive; Oct 28 - Nov 10 2026, 173 series: price .597 log loss, model .687). ARK Ranking, event odds and Pick'Em stay model-only.
Walk-forward over every series since Feb 2024; weights tuned Aug 2024 - Jun 2025, scored from Jul 2025 on.

Nov 13 2026, failed held out (Holm over 8): round share adjusted for side and buy (bo3.gg round data), Valve's four VRS factors as separate terms, new-player start from teammates, event-tier K, Bo1/Bo5 slopes, experience shrink, boosted-tree stack.

entries.short: Win chance for an ESEA league match: FACEIT elo and talent plus the RWA gap of the players each side is expected to field.
body: Logit = .316 x logit(elo .8 / talent .2) + 14.2 x RWA gap / 100.
Who is priced: the opponent's top 7 by this season's league maps (latest map x3), weighted by share, current roster only. 1NT: the match lineup or starters on file.

Held S58-S59 on the RWA gap (n 2,066, t by match day): hard top 5 .6221, 90-day top 7 by share .6192 (t -2.7), season top 7 .6130 (t -3.2). The five who actually played: .6010. The hard top 5 misses a player in 78% of matches.
Pick/ban tree: an opponent ban is HABIT (their least-played map) 90%, EDGE (minimax on map edges) 10%, fit on the played map of 11,606 Bo1s, held 1,715: log loss 1.685 -> 1.632 (t -4.6).
League log: every Main match (and Advanced where ratings exist) priced before the start with team-level inputs, scored after. Forward record only.

entries.short: Valve Major Pick'Em picks with the best chance of each coin tier.
body: Coin: 11 challenges (Silver 4, Gold 8, Diamond 11); 5 free, 6 skill: 5+ of 10 per Swiss stage, bracket 2 QF / 1 SF / final.
Stage picks: two 3-0, two 0-3, six 3-1 or 3-2 (exact record). Picked once the stage field and round 1 are known.
A stage's picks move only that stage's chance, so every tier wants max P(5+ correct), not max expected correct.
P(5+) from joint stage sims (Valve pairing, Buchholz, Bo1 / Bo3; team strength drawn once per sim, sd .45 logit).
Search: exact max-expected set, then hill-climb on P(5+), scored on a second set of sims. Bracket: max P(all 3).
Held out since Jul 2025, 15 Swiss stages: predicted pass 47%, actual 47% (seed chalk 40%, VRS 47%).
Mean correct 4.00 vs chalk 4.33 (t -0.96): no reliable edge over chalk in Swiss stages.
Max P(5+) and max expected correct pick the same set in 21 of 25 stages; where they differ, < 1 pt of pass chance.
12 held-out brackets: 1.92 of 3 bracket challenges vs chalk 1.42, VRS 1.50.
